critical_code_review_comments: common.js Tabs component correctly implements role=tablist/tab/tabpanel + arrow/Home/End keyboard nav + aria-selected + roving tabIndex — meets WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
common.js ReadMore uses aria-expanded + aria-controls + hidden attribute (not display:none), which is screen-reader friendly and preserves exact prototype texts in children.

Demo.js LayerPanel enforces single-open-layer invariant via parent perStep[step].layer state (not per-component local state), which also allows persistence across reload via sessionStorage — clean design.

backend/server.py count_words uses str.split() on bare strings only, correctly handles None via `if t`; module_minutes assumes 200 words/min; estimated_minutes = max(1, round(words/200)) — floor at 1 min avoids showing '0 min' for tiny concepts.

ModulePage renders ModuleCta inside SummaryCard via children slot — only module page uses this; concept page has no CTA by design (correct per spec which says 'action button visible' only for module).
LayerPanel.LAYER_PROTO is a hardcoded French text map kept in sync with proto; consider sourcing from backend to avoid drift, but acceptable for prototype fidelity.
No horizontal scroll at 375px verified on /demo, /modules/M09, /concepts/concept-rag, /ressources, / — overflow-x:hidden on html,body in index.css acts as safety net.
